description: Land Titile Settlement Department - Siyambalanduwa, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Monaragala District   - Cad. Map No. 720005
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in Siyambalanduwa. It contains detailed land parcel numbers, ownership details, and legal declarations related to land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
